review.official:
Gitano is a mystic from
Sami
,
tarot
expert and a great card player. She has never spoken to anyone of her past prior coming to
Rhodes Island
, and it remains a mystery. All anyone knows is that her readings are very accurate.

files.description:
Imaging tests for this Operator showed blurry outlines of internal organs with visible dark spots. Unusually high concentrations of Originium particles were present in her circulatory system, indicating infection and confirming her as Infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 5% 
The infection could be related to Operator Gitano's arcane abilities, though this has yet been proven.. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.3u/L 
Infection approaching mid-stage, Originium beginning to have physical effects that are not obvious.

A fortune teller cannot tell her own future, but she can read the omens and guide her choices. She has the power to create devastating explosions with her Originium crystal ball, but she must also withstand the backlash.

Divination is a hobby to Gitano that she does almost for free, accepting fruits and cakes as a token payment. Her clients ask for readings on anything from the future to a misplaced key. Just like any soothsayer, Gitano gives ambiguous answers that require some careful thought to decipher.

Unlike her relaxed composure during a reading, Gitano gets anxious easily and becomes very competitive when playing cards. She is never allowed to shuffle the deck out of fear that she'll cheat. Even then, she knows countless other card tricks, and unless she's caught red-handed, she'll never admit to cheating. Still, some people play with her because they either want to catch her in the act, or see a nervous side of her she doesn't otherwise show.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Alright, Doctor, your tarot card for today is...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Would you like to learn more about your future?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Bear it in mind that excessive reliance on unfathomed power will eventually backfire on us.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Tarot cards aren't divine, all-seeing tools. Instead, we use them for guidance when we feel lost.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Destiny is like the world we walk upon—no one can escape it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Humans might never be able to escape this world... but we can change it. Our actions belie endless possibilities.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There are countless topics for which you can consult the tarot, the most common one being your luck in card games. To change it, however, you must be brave enough to change your fate first.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: We have a ritual among diviners that's all the rage these days. We call it the 'Hand of Fate.' Would you like to try it?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: It's a divination taboo to do readings concerning death. But I don't believe death is the end—it's the beginning of something new.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Dreams can often enlighten you in strange ways. If you have an enlightening dream like that, you'd best remember every detail, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Following the guidance of the arcana, our paths have finally converged. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I feel inspired now.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'd already foreseen this promotion in my crystal ball. Heheh, just kidding.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You want to know your destiny, Doctor? Too bad, I can't help you. I'm not the one to share it with you, for the fate forbids me to do so.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Wait a minute, let me predict the results of this battle.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Well then, let me pray for everyone.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Fate is a fickle thing... only the victorious will be forever revered.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I can see the outcome. Victory belongs to Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: A very wise choice.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: My turn.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Draw a card.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Do not resist your fate.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The tower of void.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The flying chariot.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The Emperor's scepter shall break.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: All will fall before the Priestess's might.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Will fate have us in a chokehold… or will we turn the table?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I have moved all of them to the graveyard.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Time to reshuffle the deck.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Impossible... this isn't what I saw in the cards...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Bad omens seem to lurk inside this room. May I use my powers to help you manage them?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm? What can I do for you?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Want me to do a reading on your future? All right, please give me a minute.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy new year, Doctor. I bet you are eager to learn your fortune this year from me, aren't you? I have, truth be told, stolen a peek into it. My divination was reliable, as always. Still, only by unveiling the fate's mask with your own hands will you discover what lies beneath, don't you agree? No need to worry, I will be there to help you.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, you're blessed by the winds of luck.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. As my birthday gift for you, I will answer any one question from you about the future. Yes, anything will be fine. I would like to remind you though, that I don't offer this kind of chance everyday, so think twice before you ask.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: There's no preordained path where one shall walk, nor predestined fate which one shall suffer. And everyone on Rhodes Island has proved that many, many times. Here, Doctor, Peek into the crystal ball. As long as your heart is not shadowed by the clouds, you will see the light of hope at the end of the haze.
